============================================================ Dead Of Alive: Xtream Venus Vaction Pack ============================================================ This pack brings Leifang from DOAXVV into Left 4 Dead 2! It replaces all survivors across both groups (L4D1 & L4D2). [FEATURES] - Full survivor replacements (Bill, Francis, Louis, Zoey, Nick, Coach, Ellis, Rochelle) - Clean models, custom textures, and materials - Standalone single-survivor VPKs mixed with All-in-One variants - Contains mature model adjustments - Two different model skins This package includes 10 standalone VPK files. Pick and choose exactly what you want to install in your addons folder: • survivor_bill.vpk -> Replaces Bill only • survivor_francis.vpk -> Replaces Francis only • survivor_louis.vpk -> Replaces Louis only • survivor_zoey.vpk -> Replaces Zoey only • survivor_coach.vpk -> Replaces Coach only • survivor_ellis.vpk -> Replaces Ellis only • survivor_nick.vpk -> Replaces Nick only • survivor_rochelle.vpk -> Replaces Rochelle only • all-in-one.vpk -> Replaces EVERY survivor at once • all-in-one v2.vpk -> Replaces EVERY survivor, but includes Zoey's voice only

item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
Hello everyone! The version of ContraZ on GameMaps had been left abandoned and outdated at v0.5, while the Steam version continued to evolve. I’m happy to announce that I’ve worked on and modified the campaign to bring the **latest version (v0.7)** directly here—fully ready for you to enjoy. Furthermore, I will be providing **ongoing support** and updates to ensure the best possible gameplay experience. Enjoy this release, inspired by *Contra*, and please don’t hesitate to leave your feedback or report any issues!
